source_refs: Heidegger GA7 QCT airliner / Bestand example

from_node.description: An airliner is positioned in an operational transport system and kept ready for dispatch, maintenance and replacement of components.

to_node.description: Within that ordering context, the airliner can be analysed as standing-reserve insofar as its presence is organized through availability-for-use rather than autonomous objecthood alone.

bridge.statement: The Heideggerian example ties Bestand to being on call, orderable and systemically available.

bs4.availability: kept ready for dispatch and integrated into transport demand
bs4.substitutability: components and system function are organized around replaceability and maintained availability
bs4.demand_linkage: transport demand orders the aircraft into a chain of scheduling, fueling, maintenance and logistics
bs4.stock_flow_status: operational asset within a transport flow
bs4.autonomy_shift: its system meaning is dominated by readiness/function rather than isolated object-presence
bs4.context_dependence: outside the operational ordering it can also be encountered historically, aesthetically or materially
bs4.reversibility: the same artifact can enter alternative practices/descriptions, so standing-reserve is not simple numerical identity with the object
bs4.counterdescription: artifact/function analysis explains many local properties without itself implying an epochal mode of revealing
bs4.revision_trigger: a case in which availability/substitutability are absent but the strong Bestand claim is still asserted
